scripts.build: npm --prefix tembea-backend run build && npm --prefix tembea-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix tembea-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix tembea-frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix tembea-backend run lint:check && npm --prefix tembea-frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix tembea-backend test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix tembea-frontend run test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
